JSONata 2.1.0 (MIT), https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsonata/v/2.1.0.

Evaluates the installed ComfyUI nodes' price_badge expressions locally. The UMD distribution is unchanged inside an ESM wrapper. No network access is used at runtime.
